result.summary: The page is mostly visually coherent, but it exposes an untranslated localization key and the fixed bottom navigation obscures content near the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the translation key and display the intended localized heading, such as "Popular near you".

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card, hiding its image and likely its details or actions.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or adjust the navigation overlay behavior so the final card can be viewed completely.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel is visibly clipped at the right edge, leaving the third card and restaurant name partially cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel clearly communicates horizontal scrolling and provide appropriate spacing or partial-card treatment at the viewport edge.
